attchmntText: Archies Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Archies Limited Board of Directors approved Un-Audited Financial Results for the Quarter and Half Year ended 30th September 2026. The company reported a loss of 157.62 Lakhs for the quarter ended 30th September 2026, compared to a loss of 25.21 Lakhs in the same period last year. For the half year ended 30th September 2026, the loss was 295.86 Lakhs, versus a profit of 4.79 Lakhs in the previous year. Revenue from operations stood at 1239.28 Lakhs for the quarter and 2030.07 Lakhs for the half year. Basic Earnings Per Share was negative 0.47 Rupees for the quarter and negative 0.88 Rupees for the half year. The Statutory Auditors issued a Limited Review Report noting that the company has not deposited Employees Provident Fund for April 2026 to September 2026 and Tax Deducted at Source for May 2026 to September 2026.

attchmntText: Archies Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 08, 2026, titled "Newspaper Publication for Notice of Board Meeting to be held on 14th November 2026".
voiceSummary: Archies Limited filed newspaper advertisements for a Board Meeting scheduled on 14th November 2026 to consider and approve Un-Audited Financial Results for the quarter ended 30th September 2026. Edayar Zinc Limited announced its Twenty-Sixth Annual General Meeting on 28th November 2026 via video conferencing. The register of members remains closed from 20th November 2026 to 27th November 2026. Remote e-voting is available from 25th November 2026 at 9:00 a.m. to 27th November 2026 at 5:00 p.m. Lancer Container Lines Limited approved Un-Audited Financial Results for the quarter ended 30th September 2026. Mawana Sugars Limited reported a net loss of 132.96 million for the six months ended 30th September 2026.
